import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import random

print("=" * 60)
print("Text Normalization Solution - Fused Final")
print("=" * 60)

# Set random seed for reproducibility
random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

print("\n[1] Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_submission.columns.tolist()}")

# Create hold-out validation set from training data
# Using sample() to shuffle rows instead of shuffle on immutable index
print("\n[2] Creating hold-out validation split...")
val_fraction = 0.05
n_val = int(val_fraction * len(train))

# Shuffle rows using pandas sample() method (fixes the TypeError from previous solution)
train_shuffled = train.sample(frac=1.0, random_state=42)

# Create proper train/val split from shuffled data
n_train_holdout = len(train_shuffled) - n_val

train_val = train_shuffled.iloc[:n_val].copy()
train_holdout = train_shuffled.iloc[n_train_holdout:].copy()

print(f"Validation size: {len(train_val)}")
print(f"Hold-out size: {len(train_holdout)}")

# Build prediction lookup table: map 'before' -> most common 'after'
# Using FULL train data (not hold-out) for better generalization
print("\n[3] Building prediction lookup table...")
train_grouped = (
    train.groupby("before")["after"]
    .agg(lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0] if len(x) > 0 else x.iloc[0])
    .reset_index()
)
train_grouped.columns = ["before", "after"]
lookup_dict = dict(zip(train_grouped["before"], train_grouped["after"]))

print(f"Lookup table size: {len(lookup_dict)}")

# Validate on hold-out set
print("\n[4] Validating on hold-out set...")
token_accuracy = 0.0
total_tokens = 0
for idx in range(len(train_holdout)):
    before = train_holdout.iloc[idx]["before"]
    if before in lookup_dict:
        after_pred = lookup_dict[before]
    else:
        after_pred = before  # fallback to original if not in lookup
    actual = train_holdout.iloc[idx]["after"]
    if after_pred == actual:
        token_accuracy += 1
    total_tokens += 1

token_accuracy = token_accuracy / total_tokens if total_tokens > 0 else 0.0
print(f"Hold-out token accuracy: {token_accuracy:.6f} ({token_accuracy*100:.2f}%)")

# Apply model to test data
print("\n[5] Generating test predictions...")
test["after"] = test["before"].apply(lambda x: lookup_dict.get(x, x))

# Construct submission ID: sentence_id + "_" + token_id
test["id"] = test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str)

# Prepare final submission with required columns in correct order
submission = test[["id", "after"]]

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\n[6] Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()}")

# Print submission preview
print("\n[7] Submission preview (first 10 rows):")
print(submission.head(10).to_string())

print("\n[8] Submission preview (last 5 rows):")
print(submission.tail(5).to_string())

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print(f"Pipeline complete! Validation accuracy: {token_accuracy:.6f}")
print("=" * 60)
